title: Dialz: A Python Toolkit for Steering Vectors
benchmark_measurement: Mitigation of religious stereotypes in generated text, measured by a stereotypicality rating on a scale of 1 to 10.
findings: The paper's steering vector method significantly reduced religious stereotypicality ratings in Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1's outputs, from a baseline score of 6.3 to 3.2. This method was more effective than standard anti-stereotype prompting, which only reduced the score to 4.8.
